en.title: The Letters Î and Â
en.summary: Learn how to pronounce the Romanian letters î and â with correct mouth shape and simple spelling rules.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs: Two letters in Romanian make the very same vowel sound. These letters are î and â. You hear this sound in the word (români) /roˈmɨnʲ/, which means Romanians. It is a deep, central sound. Your voice stays steady and clear when you speak it.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Start to make the sound in the word 'see'. Now, pull your tongue back into the middle of your mouth. Keep your lips flat and relaxed. Do not round your lips. Push air through your throat with a steady voice. The sound comes from deep inside.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: Both letters make the exact same sound. You usually write â inside words, as in (români) /roˈmɨnʲ/. You write î at the start of words, as in (în) /ɨn/. You also see î inside words when a root word starts with it. The pronunciation never changes.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not round your lips when you say this sound. Rounded lips make a different vowel entirely. Also, do not pronounce the two letters differently. They sound identical. Practice with the word (români) /roˈmɨnʲ/ until your tongue feels natural. Keep your jaw relaxed every time.
